Title: Two-Factor Authentication Setup
FAQ: How do I set up two-factor authentication?

Two-factor authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to your account. To enable 2FA, go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication and click Enable. We support authenticator apps (Google Authenticator, Authy) and SMS verification. Authenticator apps are recommended over SMS for stronger security. After enabling 2FA, you will be prompted for a verification code at each login.
--- End Document 1 ---

final_answer: Multi-factor authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to accounts by requiring two or more credentials for authentication. This approach significantly reduces the risk of unauthorized access, even if one credential is compromised. 2FA typically involves using a combination of methods like authenticator apps (e.g., Google Authenticator), SMS verification, or physical tokens to verify identity. The knowledge base documents retrieved confirm that many organizations implement 2FA for accounts with administrative privileges.
